risks.description: Public upload changes break existing preview, commerce, or playback behavior.
risks.mitigation: Additive schema, feature flags, regression tests, and existing Jukebox/access reuse.

risks.description: False AI classification harms human artists.
risks.mitigation: Declarations plus private risk signals, human review, appeal, and no public detector accusation.

risks.description: Evidence or unreleased audio is exposed.
risks.mitigation: Private storage, narrow signed URLs, RLS, capability checks, and access logging.

risks.description: Certification language implies legal ownership or guaranteed AI absence.
risks.mitigation: Versioned narrow claims, legal review, disclaimers, suspension and revocation.

risks.description: Legacy catalog is mislabeled or automatically certified.
risks.mitigation: Explicit migration workflow and default non-certified status.
